up: Return exact IC50 values in nM for compounds tested against human mTOR kinase. For each result, provide the ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, PubMed ID or DOI (preferring PubMed ID when both exist), assay description, target ChEMBL ID, target preferred name, target organism, and target type.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_pref_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  td.target_type
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'mTOR kinase'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
